roleOrg.en: Creator of Ruby on Rails & Omarchy
roleOrg.zh: Ruby on Rails 与 Omarchy 创建者

bio.en: David Heinemeier Hansson (DHH) is the creator of Ruby on Rails and Omarchy, a co-owner and co-founder of 37signals, and a best-selling author. He co-authored REWORK, REMOTE, It Doesn't Have to Be Crazy at Work, and Getting Real with Jason Fried. He also chairs the Rails Foundation and serves on Shopify's board of directors.
bio.zh: David Heinemeier Hansson（DHH）是 Ruby on Rails 与 Omarchy 的创建者、37signals 的共同所有人兼联合创始人，也是畅销书作者。他与 Jason Fried 合著《REWORK》《REMOTE》《It Doesn't Have to Be Crazy at Work》和《Getting Real》，并担任 Rails Foundation 主席及 Shopify 董事。

roleOrg.zh: Google Cloud 解决方案架构师

bio.en: Jie Wang is a Solutions Architect at Google Cloud.
bio.zh: 王捷是 Google Cloud 解决方案架构师。

roleOrg.zh: Google Cloud 解决方案架构师

bio.en: Peace He is a Solutions Architect at Google Cloud.
bio.zh: 何平是 Google Cloud 解决方案架构师。

roleOrg.en: vLLM-Omni Core Maintainer, Chief Architect of InferMatrix Project
roleOrg.zh: vLLM-Omni 核心维护者、InferMatrix Project 首席架构师

bio.en: Hongsheng Liu is a core maintainer of vLLM-Omni and Chief Architect of the InferMatrix Project.
bio.zh: 刘红升是 vLLM-Omni 核心维护者、InferMatrix Project 首席架构师。

roleOrg.en: Engineer at Inferact, vLLM Community Contributor
roleOrg.zh: Inferact 工程师、vLLM 社区贡献者

bio.en: Jiangyun Zhu is an engineer at Inferact and a contributor to the vLLM community.
bio.zh: 朱江云是 Inferact 工程师，也是 vLLM 社区贡献者。

roleOrg.zh: AMD 产品应用工程师

bio.en: Wei Cai is a Product Application Engineer at AMD, focusing on AI and high-performance computing solutions. She helps developers use AI frameworks, libraries, and tools to build efficient, reliable applications.
bio.zh: 蔡薇是 AMD 产品应用工程师，专注于人工智能与高性能计算解决方案，帮助开发者使用 AI 框架、软件库和工具构建高效、可靠的应用。

roleOrg.zh: AMD AI 解决方案架构师

bio.en: Charles Yang is a core technical instructor for Agentic AI and Physical AI at AMD China and an architect focused on AI ecosystem development.
bio.zh: AMD 中国 Agentic AI 与 Physical AI 核心技术讲师，专注于 AI 生态建设与解决方案架构。

roleOrg.en: Ph.D. Student, Tsinghua University / Approaching AI
roleOrg.zh: 清华大学 / Approaching AI 博士生

bio.en: Peilin Li is a Ph.D. student at Tsinghua University, supervised by Mingxing Zhang, and a core contributor to KTransformers and LLaMA-Factory. His research focuses on inference and fine-tuning on heterogeneous GPU–CPU systems and inference optimization for large-scale clusters.
bio.zh: 清华大学博士生，师从张明兴教授，也是 KTransformers 与 LLaMA-Factory 等开源项目的核心贡献者。研究方向包括 GPU–CPU 异构系统上的推理与微调，以及大规模集群推理优化。

roleOrg.zh: 联合讲师

bio.en: Yujie Yang is a co-presenter of “KTransformers: The Fine-Tuning-to-Inference Closed Loop for Full-Precision 1T-Class MoE Models on Consumer Hardware” at GOSIM Shenzhen 2026.
bio.zh: Yujie Yang 将在 GOSIM 深圳 2026 联合分享《KTransformers：消费级硬件上全精度万亿参数级 MoE 模型的微调到推理闭环》。

roleOrg.zh: 字节跳动软件工程师

bio.en: Wilson Wang is a software engineer on ByteDance’s Global Traffic Infrastructure team, specializing in virtual machines and WebAssembly. His interests include operating systems, distributed systems, cloud-native technologies, edge computing, and serverless architectures.
bio.zh: 字节跳动全球流量基础设施团队软件工程师，专注于虚拟机与 WebAssembly，并关注操作系统、分布式系统、云原生技术、边缘计算和无服务器架构。

roleOrg.zh: 建元科技创始人

bio.en: Peng Zhang is the founder of Genmeta Technology and an advocate for DHttp.
bio.zh: 张鹏，建元科技创始人，DHttp 布道师。

roleOrg.en: Group Leader, Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems / ELLIS Institute Tübingen
roleOrg.zh: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所研究组负责人 / 图宾根 ELLIS 研究所首席研究员

bio.en: Shiwei Liu leads a research group at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and is a Principal Investigator at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen. Previously, he was a Royal Society Newton International Fellow at the University of Oxford and a postdoctoral fellow at the University of Texas at Austin. He received his Ph.D. with Cum Laude honors from Eindhoven University of Technology in 2022. His work focuses broadly on the full lifecycle of large foundation models.
bio.zh: 现任马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所研究组负责人、图宾根 ELLIS 研究所首席研究员。曾获英国皇家学会牛顿国际学者资助，并先后在牛津大学和德州大学奥斯汀分校从事研究。2022 年以最高荣誉获得埃因霍温理工大学博士学位，研究涵盖大型基础模型的完整生命周期。

roleOrg.zh: 南京大学副教授、博士生导师

bio.en: Jiaqi Zheng is an associate professor and doctoral supervisor at the School of Computer Science, Nanjing University. His current research focuses on supernode interconnection systems. He has presided over projects funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, including the Excellent Young Scientists Fund, the General Program, and the Young Scientists Fund, as well as corporate innovation funds from Huawei, Alibaba, ByteDance, Tencent, and other companies. He has published over 100 academic papers in top-tier international venues such as SIGCOMM, NSDI, and NIPS, and has received the Best Paper Award at CCF-recommended international conferences three times. Three of his authorized patents have been transferred to Huawei Central Research Institute. His related achievements have been incorporated into core computer science curricula at leading universities in the United States, have been specially cited in the U.S. National Science Foundation's 2024 Milestone Report.
bio.zh: 南京大学计算机学院副教授、博士生导师，研究方向聚焦超节点互连系统。主持国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金、面上项目和青年项目，以及华为、阿里巴巴、字节跳动、腾讯等企业创新基金；在 SIGCOMM、NSDI、NeurIPS 等国际会议发表论文百余篇，多次获得 CCF 推荐国际会议最佳论文奖。

roleOrg.zh: Dimforge 创始人

bio.en: Sébastien Crozet has been in love with the Rust programming language since its earliest days. He is the creator and maintainer of popular open-source libraries, including nalgebra and Rapier, for the Rust ecosystem that specialize in linear algebra, geometry, and physics. He is the founder of Dimforge where he focuses on contributing to the future of cross-platform scientific computing and AI.
bio.zh: Rust 生态中 nalgebra、Rapier 等知名开源库的创建者和维护者，长期专注于线性代数、几何与物理计算。他创立 Dimforge，致力于推动跨平台科学计算和 AI 的发展。

roleOrg.en: Associate Researcher, Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society
roleOrg.zh: 深圳市人工智能与机器人研究院副研究员

bio.en: Liuwang Kang received his Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of Virginia, where he also conducted postdoctoral research. He previously worked as a Senior Project Scientist at VMASC and as a Staff Engineer at Baidu. He is now an Associate Researcher at the Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society, focusing on multi-agent coordination, 6G-enabled embodied intelligence, and complex-system simulation.
bio.zh: 获弗吉尼亚大学计算机科学博士学位，并在该校从事博士后研究。曾任美国 VMASC 高级项目科学家和百度高级工程师，现任深圳市人工智能与机器人研究院副研究员，研究方向包括多智能体协同、6G 赋能的具身智能和复杂系统仿真。

roleOrg.zh: 联合讲师

bio.en: Hongjun Zhou is an Associate Researcher at the Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society. His research focuses on robot perception, navigation, and bipedal robot control. He previously worked on service and home robot development at Alibaba and the ASUS Intelligent Robot Center.
bio.zh: 深圳市人工智能与机器人研究院副研究员，研究方向包括机器人感知、导航和双足机器人控制。曾在阿里巴巴和华硕智能机器人中心参与服务机器人与家庭机器人研发。

roleOrg.zh: Makeitfuture 联合创始人兼 CEO

bio.en: I'm Tiberiu Socaci, CEO & Co-Founder of Makeitfuture — a leading AI and automation agency across the UK, France, Germany, and Romania. I'm passionate about digital transformation and helping businesses streamline complex workflows using AI, Make.com, Airtable, n8n, and no-code solutions. We worked with companies like Celonis, Avidly, BCG, and Billwerk to simplify processes and drive real growth. The whole thing started with Blu Coffee, Romania's first specialty coffee subscription, which I fully automated using Make.com. That turned into a company that's now delivered 15,000+ automations and been recognized by Make.com as their AI Partner of the Year and #1 No-Code Agency EMEA in 2024. Lately, I've been building a new type of application — self-evolving apps — that learn from user corrections without any machine learning. My mission is to empower organizations by making AI practical, accessible, and smarter with every use.
bio.zh: Makeitfuture 联合创始人兼 CEO，专注于利用 AI、Make.com、Airtable、n8n 和无代码工具帮助企业实现数字化转型与复杂流程自动化。其团队已交付超过 15,000 项自动化方案，并获 Make.com 评选为 2024 年度 AI 合作伙伴及欧洲、中东和非洲地区排名第一的无代码机构。他目前致力于构建能够从用户纠正中持续学习的自演进应用。

roleOrg.en: Head of EU Policy, OpenMined Foundation
roleOrg.zh: OpenMined Foundation 欧盟政策主管

bio.en: Peter Ide-Kostic is Head of EU Policy at the OpenMined Foundation, leading its European engagement on AI governance, data policy and privacy-enhancing technologies. He brings more than 15 years of EU technology-policy experience, including as a European Parliament official supporting the LIBE, IMCO and AIDA committee secretariats and the STOA Panel. An EU Fellow and former visiting scholar at UC San Diego, his work focuses on trustworthy AI, responsible data access and European technological sovereignty. He participates in a personal capacity in the European Commission’s Expert Forum on Frontier AI and represented OpenMined at the inaugural UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance in July 2026.
bio.zh: 负责 OpenMined Foundation 在欧洲的 AI 治理、数据政策和隐私增强技术事务，拥有超过 15 年的欧盟技术政策经验。其工作聚焦可信 AI、负责任的数据访问和欧洲技术主权，并以个人身份参与欧盟委员会前沿 AI 专家论坛。

roleOrg.zh: Ingora 创始人兼 CEO

bio.en:
Jacky Hsu is the Founder of Ingora, an AI-native learning companion company building next-generation AI companion devices for children.

Previously, he spent over 20 years at Microsoft as a product leader, where he led product strategy and growth initiatives across multiple businesses including SharePoint Copilot and Agent. He played a key role in bringing Copilot and Agent experiences into real-world enterprise scenarios.

Jacky combines deep expertise in AI product design with a unique perspective on integrating agent systems, education, and hardware. At Ingora, he is exploring how AI companions can reshape how children learn, think, and grow.
bio.zh: Ingora 创始人兼 CEO，致力于打造面向儿童的新一代 AI 学习伙伴设备。此前在微软拥有超过 20 年产品领导经验，曾负责 SharePoint Copilot 与 Agent 等业务的产品战略和增长。目前探索智能体系统、教育与硬件的结合，以及 AI 伙伴如何重塑儿童的学习和成长方式。

roleOrg.zh: OpenCV.org 首席执行官

bio.en: Dr. Satya Mallick is the CEO of OpenCV.org - the non-profit that maintains the largest computer vision library in the world. He is an entrepreneur in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning. Before starting his AI consulting company, Big Vision LLC, he co-founded Sight Commerce Inc (formerly Taaz Inc.), where he built AI products that reached over 100M users. His work has been covered in publications like TechCrunch, Huffington Post, NYTimes, and WSJ. Dr. Mallick is also the creator of some of the most popular online computer vision and AI courses. In 2017, IBM's AI Blog named Dr. Mallick as one of the top 20 people in AI to follow on Twitter.
bio.zh: OpenCV.org CEO，长期从事人工智能、计算机视觉和机器学习领域的创业与研发。他曾联合创办 Sight Commerce，并打造服务超过一亿用户的 AI 产品；同时也是广受欢迎的计算机视觉与 AI 在线课程创作者。

roleOrg.en: Founder & CEO, Lumo AI Compliance & Advisory
roleOrg.zh: Lumo AI Compliance & Advisory 创始人兼 CEO

bio.en: Kelly Policarpo is the founder of Lumo AI Compliance & Advisory and specializes in AI governance and entry into the European market. With a background in computer science and product management, she works across AI compliance, privacy, cybersecurity, and product strategy. Based in Portugal, she helps technology companies, particularly those from Asia and the Greater Bay Area, prepare for the EU AI Act and related governance requirements as they enter and grow in Europe.
bio.zh: AI 治理与欧盟市场准入专家，创立 Lumo AI Compliance & Advisory，帮助 AI 企业为进入欧洲市场做好准备。她拥有计算机科学和产品管理背景，专业领域涵盖 AI 合规、隐私、网络安全与产品战略，重点帮助企业理解欧盟《人工智能法案》及相关治理要求。

roleOrg.en: AI, Data & HPC Expert, LUMI AI Factory / CYFRONET AGH / European Commission
roleOrg.zh: LUMI AI Factory / CYFRONET AGH / 欧盟委员会 AI、数据与高性能计算专家

bio.en: Katarzyna Starosławska is a data, AI, and high-performance computing specialist with more than 20 years of experience across technology, strategy, and innovation. She advises corporate boards, public institutions, and the European Union on data quality, interoperability, and cross-sector collaboration. Her roles include work with the European Commission’s next-generation interoperability expert group and AI in Science working groups, EuroHPC / LUMI AI Factory at CYFRONET AGH, and Poland’s Ministry of Digital Affairs. She also serves on the business council of the Speakleash / Bielik.ai Foundation and advises research and health organizations.
bio.zh: 拥有超过 20 年技术、战略与创新经验的数据和 AI 专家，为企业董事会、公共机构及欧盟提供咨询。她关注数据质量、互操作性和跨行业协作，并参与欧盟委员会下一代互操作框架专家组、AI 科学工作组及 EuroHPC / LUMI AI Factory 等项目。

roleOrg.zh: 微软首席项目经理

bio.en: Senior AI Product Leader with 10+ years at Microsoft Azure AI, specializing in Speech AI and Voice Agents. Experienced in product strategy, 0-to-1 product development, and global commercialization. Combines B2B and B2C product expertise with deep strengths in human-centered design, AI product experience, and ecosystem development to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into scalable products and lasting business value.
bio.zh: 拥有十余年微软 Azure AI 经验的资深 AI 产品负责人，专注于语音 AI 与语音智能体。具备产品战略、从零到一产品开发和全球商业化经验，致力于将前沿 AI 技术转化为可规模化的产品和长期业务价值。

roleOrg.zh: Global AI Assembly 创始人兼 CEO

bio.en: Feliana Citradewi is the Founder and CEO of Global AI Assembly.
bio.zh: Global AI Assembly 创始人兼 CEO。

roleOrg.zh: NVIDIA 开发者技术首席工程师

bio.en: Markus Tavenrath is a Principal Engineer in Developer Technology at NVIDIA. He studied computer graphics at RWTH Aachen University and joined NVIDIA in 2008 to work on GPU-based real-time ray tracing. His work spans performance optimization for ray tracing, scene graphs, OpenGL, WebGL, Vulkan, and AI. He co-founded Vulkan-Hpp and chairs the Khronos Machine Learning Council.
bio.zh: NVIDIA 开发者技术首席工程师，长期从事 GPU 实时光线追踪以及场景图、OpenGL、WebGL、Vulkan 和 AI 的性能优化。他是 Vulkan-Hpp 项目的联合创始人，现任 Khronos 机器学习委员会主席。

roleOrg.zh: Known Unknowns GmbH 负责人

bio.en: Igor Schwarzmann is Principal of Known Unknowns GmbH in Berlin and a strategic advisor working at the intersection of culture and technology. He has 20 years of experience across healthcare, automotive, luxury, media, and government, working with technology companies, multinationals, and institutions internationally. He runs his practice on open-source, local-first agentic AI infrastructure and hosts Follow the Rabbit, a podcast about cultural phenomena and European AI sovereignty.
bio.zh: 文化与技术交叉领域的战略顾问，拥有 20 年跨医疗、汽车、奢侈品、媒体和政府领域经验，曾服务全球科技公司、欧洲跨国企业及公共机构。他以开源、本地优先的智能体 AI 基础设施运营自己的咨询业务，并主持探讨文化现象与欧洲 AI 主权的播客 Follow the Rabbit。

roleOrg.zh: 华为开源训练软件技术专家

bio.en: CodingMa holds a master's degree from Peking University and has worked extensively on training systems for NLP and large language models. At Huawei, he focuses on building the native open-source ecosystem for Ascend training, leads technical collaborations and planning with post-training communities, and contributes as a committer to LLaMA-Factory.
bio.zh: 硕士毕业于北京大学，长期从事 NLP 与大语言模型训练系统相关工作，负责昇腾训练方向的原生开源生态建设，参与并主导多个后训练社区的技术合作与规划，同时担任 LLaMA-Factory 社区 committer。

roleOrg.zh: Reflexion Robotics 创始人兼 CTO

bio.en: Charbel Dandjinou is the founder and CTO of Reflexion Robotics, a Paris-based startup building A OS, a safety runtime for embodied AI. Previously an AI research engineer and MLOps technical lead at EXXACT Robotics, he also founded IROKO and the Deep Takka research lab to make AI more accessible and inclusive.
bio.zh: Reflexion Robotics 创始人兼 CTO，致力于开发面向具身智能的安全运行时 A OS。曾任 EXXACT Robotics AI 研究工程师及 MLOps 技术负责人，并创立 IROKO 与 Deep Takka 研究实验室，推动 AI 技术普及与包容性发展。

roleOrg.zh: Marso Robotics AI 负责人

bio.en: Alba María Téllez Fernández is AI Lead at Marso Robotics and the main developer of the open-source simulation projects AlpaBridge and URDF Studio. She works at the intersection of world models, agentic AI, and cybersecurity for robotics and autonomous vehicles.
bio.zh: Marso Robotics AI 负责人，也是开源仿真项目 AlpaBridge 与 URDF Studio 的主要开发者。她的工作聚焦世界模型、智能体 AI，以及机器人和自动驾驶系统的网络安全。

roleOrg.zh: 元枢智汇联合创始人

bio.en: Meiyi Qiang is a core developer of the OpenDCAI open-source projects, with a focus on the DataFlow AI data preparation system and the DataFlex dynamic training system. Her work spans data-centric AI, data-model co-training, and dynamic data optimization. She has published seven papers in CCF-A journals and conferences and now leads AI data infrastructure solutions and commercialization as Co-Founder of Yuanshu Zhihui.
bio.zh: OpenDCAI 系列开源项目核心技术开发者，重点参与 AI 数据准备系统 DataFlow 与动态训练系统 DataFlex 的研发与落地，研究方向涵盖 Data-Centric AI、数据—模型协同训练与动态数据优化。个人累计发表 CCF-A 类期刊及会议论文 7 篇，现作为元枢智汇联合创始人，负责 AI 数据基础设施的解决方案与商业落地。

roleOrg.zh: Pleias 联合创始人兼 CEO

bio.en: Anastasia Stasenko is Co-Founder and CEO of Pleias, a Franco-German lab developing data infrastructure for frontier AI systems. Under her leadership, Pleias created Common Corpus, an open multilingual dataset for LLM training with more than two trillion tokens, and led SYNTH, which produces open synthetic data at scale for sovereign AI models and agentic applications. She is also a Senior Associate Lecturer at Sorbonne Nouvelle University and came to AI through digital humanities and philosophy at the École Normale Supérieure.
bio.zh: 法德 AI 实验室 Pleias 联合创始人兼 CEO，负责面向前沿 AI 系统的数据基础设施。Pleias 创建了拥有超过两万亿 token 的开放多语言大模型训练数据集 Common Corpus，并通过 SYNTH 大规模生产用于主权 AI 模型和智能体应用的开放合成数据。她同时任巴黎第三大学高级副讲师，拥有数字人文和哲学背景。

roleOrg.zh: 联合讲师

bio.en: Pieter Delobelle is a co-presenter of “SynthCommonCorpus: The Largest Open Synthetic Pretraining Corpus Built for Agentic Models” at GOSIM Shenzhen 2026.
bio.zh: Pieter Delobelle 将在 GOSIM 深圳 2026 联合分享《SynthCommonCorpus：面向智能体模型构建的最大开放合成预训练语料库》。

roleOrg.zh: Hugging Face 机器学习研究工程师

bio.en: Nouamane Tazi is a Machine Learning Research Engineer at Hugging Face, specializing in training large language models. He is a co-author of SmolLM3 and The Ultra Scale Playbook, and his research spans NLP, deep learning, and scalable AI infrastructure.
bio.zh: Hugging Face 机器学习研究工程师，专注于大语言模型训练。他是 SmolLM3 和 The Ultra Scale Playbook 的共同作者，研究涵盖自然语言处理、深度学习和可扩展 AI 基础设施。

roleOrg.zh: Hugging Face 具身机器人工程师

bio.en: Aspiring mad scientist, trying to create this generation's Pinocchio. Martino Russi is a core contributor to LeRobot, the open-source robotics library, where he built and maintains the Unitree G1 humanoid stack. He is the creator of Project Homunculus, an open-source force-feedback hand exoskeleton that subsequent academic work, including HOMIE, builds on. His background spans neuroscience, AI, and robotics; his goal is to make embodied intelligence affordable for everyone.
bio.zh: LeRobot 开源机器人库核心贡献者，负责构建和维护 Unitree G1 人形机器人技术栈，也是开源力反馈手部外骨骼 Project Homunculus 的创建者。他拥有神经科学、AI 和机器人学背景，致力于让具身智能技术更加普及。

roleOrg.en: Vice Principal, Sun Yat-sen University Affiliated School (Shenzhen)
roleOrg.zh: 中山大学深圳附属学校副校长

bio.en: Yuegang Liu is a senior secondary-school art teacher and Vice Principal of Sun Yat-sen University Affiliated School in Shenzhen. Over more than 20 years in education, he has worked on school culture, brand and design management, and AI-supported collaborative learning. He developed the Three-Person Learning Group model, combining Confucian differentiated instruction with Vygotsky's zone of proximal development through intelligent grouping, collaborative inquiry, and multidimensional assessment.
bio.zh: 中学美术高级教师、中山大学深圳附属学校副校长，深耕深圳教育二十余年。长期研究学校文化、品牌与形象管理，并提出“学习沐城”理念和“三人行”小组合作式学习模型，以因材施教和最近发展区理论为基础，探索智能分组、协作探究与多维评估在 AI 时代的应用。

roleOrg.zh: NVIDIA 首席工程师

bio.en:
Bryce Adelstein Lelbach has spent over a decade developing programming languages, compilers, and libraries. He is passionate about parallel programming and strives to make it more accessible for everyone.

Bryce is a Principal Engineer at NVIDIA, where he founded the Core C++ Compute Libraries team and now leads the Vanguard Programming group that drives NVIDIA's roadmap for programming languages, compilers, and core libraries.

He is a leader of the systems programming language community, having served as chair of the C++ Library Evolution and the US programming language standards committee. He has been an organizer and program chair for many conferences over the years. On the C++ committee, he has worked on concurrency primitives, parallel algorithms, senders, and multidimensional arrays.

Outside of work, Bryce is passionate about airplanes and watches. He lives in Midtown Manhattan with his girlfriend and dog.
bio.zh: Bryce Adelstein Lelbach 长期从事编程语言、编译器和基础库开发，致力于让并行编程更易于使用。他是 NVIDIA 首席工程师，创立了核心 C++ 计算库团队，目前负责推动 NVIDIA 在编程语言、编译器和核心库方面路线图的 Vanguard Programming 团队。他曾担任 C++ 库演进工作组及美国编程语言标准委员会主席，并参与并发原语、并行算法、sender 和多维数组等标准工作。

He received his Ph.D. from the University of Tokyo in 2014 and conducted postdoctoral research at UCLA from 2014 to 2018. roleOrg.zh: AI Poland 董事会成员

bio.en:
Bartłomiej Szejny is a technology entrepreneur, independent AI researcher, and board member of AI Poland. He contributes to the development of Poland’s artificial intelligence ecosystem by combining business, technological, and strategic perspectives. His research interests focus on autonomous embodied AI agents and control mechanisms inspired by neurobiology.

He is the author of the position paper “Embodied Agents in Open-Ended Environments Require a Stress-Gated Homeostatic Meta-Controller,” submitted as a preprint in the cs.AI category. The paper introduces the SGHMC architecture, which uses a slowly evolving stress variable to coordinate reactive and deliberative behavior while maintaining explicitly defined safety boundaries. The work proposes a falsifiable research programme exploring machine homeostasis as a potential foundation for the safe autonomy of AI systems operating in open-ended and unpredictable environments.

bio.en: Shuyue Hu is a research scientist at Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. Her research focuses on agents, multi-agent systems, large language models, and game theory. She received her Ph.D. from the Chinese University of Hong Kong in 2019 and was a research fellow at the National University of Singapore. Her work has received the First Prize of the Natural Science Award from the Chinese Institute of Electronics, the DAI 2025 Best Paper Award, an AAMAS 2026 Best Student Paper nomination, and the AAMAS 2026 Best System Demonstration Award.
bio.zh: 上海人工智能实验室研究科学家，研究方向包括智能体、多智能体系统、大语言模型和博弈论。2019 年获香港中文大学博士学位，曾任新加坡国立大学研究员。其研究获得中国电子学会自然科学一等奖、DAI 2025 最佳论文奖、AAMAS 2026 最佳学生论文提名和最佳系统演示奖。

roleOrg.en: Ph.D. Candidate & Algorithm Researcher, Tsinghua University / Frontis.AI
roleOrg.zh: 清华大学博士研究生、衔远科技算法研究员

bio.en: Che Jiang is a Ph.D. candidate at Tsinghua University and an Algorithm Researcher at Frontis.AI. His research focuses on AI4AI, self-evolving agents, automated machine learning engineering, and AI for scientific discovery. His recent work includes NatureBench and Frontis-MA1/OpenMLE.
bio.zh: 清华大学博士研究生、衔远科技算法研究员，研究方向包括 AI4AI、自进化智能体、自动化机器学习工程和 AI for Science。近期工作包括 NatureBench 与 Frontis-MA1/OpenMLE。

roleOrg.zh: 联合讲师

bio.en: Kaiyan Zhang is a co-presenter of “Teaching AI to Improve AI: From Experimental Feedback to Meta-Evolution” at GOSIM Shenzhen 2026.
bio.zh: 张开颜 将在 GOSIM 深圳 2026 联合分享《教 AI 改进 AI：从实验反馈到元进化》。

roleOrg.en: Algorithm Expert, Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics
roleOrg.zh: 北京人形机器人创新中心算法专家

bio.en: Ning Liu earned his Ph.D. from Northeastern University in the United States. He has published more than 40 papers in leading conferences and journals, including NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, and IEEE TNNLS, and chairs the IEEE Standards Working Group on AI for Edge Devices.
bio.zh: 刘宁博士毕业于美国东北大学，在 NeurIPS、CVPR、ICML、IEEE TNNLS 等国际顶级会议和期刊发表论文 40 余篇，并担任 IEEE 边缘设备人工智能标准工作组主席。

roleOrg.zh: Eclipse Foundation 人工智能负责人

bio.en: Michael Berns is Head of AI at the Eclipse Foundation. With more than 23 years of international experience, he works at the intersection of open-source AI, digital transformation, and global ecosystem development, advancing vendor-neutral innovation, transparent technology standards, and digital sovereignty.
bio.zh: Eclipse Foundation 人工智能负责人，拥有二十余年国际经验，长期从事开源 AI、数字化转型和全球生态建设，致力于推动厂商中立的创新、透明技术标准和数字主权。

roleOrg.en: Professor, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications
roleOrg.zh: 重庆邮电大学教授

bio.en: Cen Ming is a professor at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications. He received his Ph.D. in optical engineering from the Graduate School of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2006. His research interests include information fusion, multi-target tracking, autonomous driving, and intelligent robotics.
bio.zh: 重庆邮电大学教授，2006 年获中国科学院研究生院光学工程博士学位。研究方向包括信息融合、多目标跟踪、自动驾驶和智能机器人。

roleOrg.en: Co-founder, Shanghai Mood Perception Intelligence Technology
roleOrg.zh: 上海心境感知智能科技联合创始人

bio.en: Baofeng Wang is a co-founder of Shanghai Mood Perception Intelligence Technology and holds an EMBA from Shanghai Jiao Tong University's Antai College. With more than 20 years of experience across internet and technology businesses, he now focuses on brain-computer interfaces, AI wearables, and agentic devices that bring perception, understanding, and feedback into real-world human-computer interaction.
bio.zh: 上海心境感知智能科技联合创始人、上海交通大学安泰 EMBA，拥有二十余年互联网及科技行业经验。当前专注于脑机接口、AI 可穿戴与智能体设备的产品创新，探索通过感知、理解与反馈创造新一代人机交互体验。

roleOrg.en: Head of Open Source Ecosystem, ModelBest
roleOrg.zh: 面壁智能开源生态负责人

bio.en: Chenzhe Jing leads the open-source ecosystem at ModelBest and supports the company's Chief Scientist. He also leads advocacy and operations for the OpenBMB community. His work spans developer communities, industry partnerships, on-device large models, intelligent hardware, and the commercialization of AI technology.
bio.zh: 面壁智能开源生态负责人、首席科学家助理，同时负责 OpenBMB 开源社区布道和运营。其工作涵盖开发者社区、产业合作、端侧大模型、智能硬件及 AI 技术产业化。

roleOrg.zh: Pleias 全栈工程师

bio.en: Iaroslav Neverov is a full-stack engineer at Pleias, a Paris-based AI company building the data layer for enterprise agentic AI. An École 42 graduate, he co-authored Pleias research on local, offline AI for knowledge work, including retrieval and RAG pipelines running on low-cost hardware.
bio.zh: 巴黎 AI 公司 Pleias 全栈工程师，参与企业智能体 AI 数据层建设。毕业于 École 42，并参与 Pleias 本地离线知识工作 AI 研究，探索在低成本硬件上运行检索与 RAG 流程。

roleOrg.en: Technical Expert, Huawei Programming Language Lab
roleOrg.zh: 华为编程语言实验室技术专家

bio.en: Bohua Zhan is a technical expert at Huawei Programming Language Lab. He earned his Ph.D. in mathematics from Princeton University in 2014 and later held postdoctoral positions at MIT and the Technical University of Munich. His research covers automated reasoning, interactive theorem provers, embedded-system modeling and verification, and applications in operating systems, distributed systems, and quantum programs.
bio.zh: 华为编程语言实验室技术专家，2014 年获普林斯顿大学数学博士学位，后在麻省理工学院和慕尼黑工业大学从事博士后研究。研究方向包括证明自动化、交互式定理证明器、嵌入式系统建模与验证，以及程序验证、操作系统、分布式系统和量子程序验证。

roleOrg.en: Global Head of Open Ecosystem, Rokid
roleOrg.zh: Rokid 全球开放生态负责人

bio.en: Weiqi Zhao leads Rokid's global developer and partner ecosystem for AI and AR glasses. A serial entrepreneur in China and the United States, he has spent more than a decade building intelligent-hardware and spatial-computing products. His current work focuses on agentic AI, human-computer interaction, open standards, developer platforms, and human-centered wearable computing.
bio.zh: 负责 Rokid AI 与 AR 眼镜的全球开发者及合作伙伴生态，拥有十余年智能硬件与空间计算产品经验。当前关注智能体 AI、人机交互、开放标准、开发者平台及以人为中心的可穿戴计算。

roleOrg.en: Co-founder, Chairman & CEO, Shenzhen Zhiweitong Technology
roleOrg.zh: 深圳智微通科技联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO

bio.en: An Chen is a co-founder, Chairman, and CEO of Shenzhen Zhiweitong Technology and Deputy Director of the Microfluidic Green Manufacturing R&D Center at the Research Institute of Tsinghua University in Shenzhen. He holds a Ph.D. from Tsinghua University and has led research and commercialization work in microfluidics, liquid cooling, and edge AI computing equipment.
bio.zh: 清华大学博士、博士后，现任深圳清华大学研究院微流控绿色制造研发中心副主任、深圳智微通科技有限公司联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO。长期从事微流控、液冷及端侧 AI 算力设备的研发与产业化。

roleOrg.zh: 李未可科技创始人兼 CEO

bio.en: Yi Ru is the founder and CEO of Lawaken Technology and a veteran smart-hardware entrepreneur with more than 20 years of consumer-electronics experience. He previously led intelligent terminals at Alibaba AI Labs, served as General Manager of Tmall Genie, and was a partner at Xiaomi TV. He founded Lawaken in 2021 to develop AI-powered consumer electronics and smart glasses.
bio.zh: 李未可科技创始人兼 CEO，拥有二十余年消费电子行业经验。曾任阿里巴巴人工智能实验室智能终端负责人、天猫精灵产品总经理及小米电视合伙人。2021 年创立李未可科技，专注于 AI 与消费电子融合及智能眼镜产品创新。

roleOrg.zh: 小米 openvela 开源项目负责人

bio.en: Chao Du leads the openvela open-source project at Xiaomi. He has more than a decade of experience in open-source and ecosystem operations across cloud computing and telecommunications, and previously founded the IMGeek developer community.
bio.zh: 小米 openvela 开源项目负责人，在云计算和通信行业拥有十余年开源及生态运营经验，曾创办 IMGeek 开发者社区。

roleOrg.en: Independent Open Source & Agentic AI Consultant
roleOrg.zh: 独立开源与智能体 AI 顾问

bio.en: Willem Jiang is an independent open-source and agentic AI consultant and a maintainer of DeerFlow. He previously worked at ByteDance's OSPO, served on the Apache Software Foundation Board of Directors, and contributed to Apache Camel, CXF, ServiceMix, and ServiceComb. His earlier roles include open-source technical expert at Huawei and Principal Engineer at Red Hat.
bio.zh: 独立开源与智能体 AI 顾问、DeerFlow 维护者。曾任字节跳动 OSPO 开源布道师和 Apache 软件基金会董事，并长期参与 Apache Camel、CXF、ServiceMix 与 ServiceComb 等项目。此前曾任华为开源技术专家及 Red Hat 首席工程师。

roleOrg.zh: Google Cloud 解决方案架构师

bio.en: Xin Tan is a Solutions Architect at Google Cloud, focusing on applications of frontier AI technologies in the gaming industry.
bio.zh: Google Cloud 解决方案架构师，专注于 AI 前沿技术在游戏行业的应用。

roleOrg.en: PhD, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications
roleOrg.zh: 重庆邮电大学自动化学院博士

bio.en: Ruping Cen is affiliated with the School of Automation at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications. His research focuses on mobile robot navigation and multi-sensor localization. He created MickRobot, an open-source dual-arm humanoid robotics project spanning mechanical design, hardware integration, perception, and navigation.
bio.zh: Ruping Cen 任职于重庆邮电大学自动化学院，研究方向为移动机器人导航及多传感器融合定位。他创建了开源双臂人形机器人项目 MickRobot，涵盖机械设计、硬件集成、感知定位与导航控制。

roleOrg.en: Embodied AI Developer, Beijing Dora Intelligence
roleOrg.zh: 北京道瑞智能具身智能开发者

bio.en: Keshu Han is an embodied AI developer and a contributor to the DORA community.
bio.zh: 具身智能开发者，DORA 社区贡献者。

roleOrg.zh: 句子互动创始人兼 CEO

bio.en: Jiarui Li is the founder and CEO of Juzi.bot and a serial entrepreneur with more than a decade of experience in AI. A Microsoft AI MVP and Regional Director, she is a pioneer and advocate for enterprise agentic AI employees in China. Juzi.bot's products serve more than a thousand large enterprises and government organizations across retail, public services, finance, internet, and education.
bio.zh: 句子互动创始人兼 CEO，深耕 AI 十余年，是国内企业级 Agentic AI 员工领域的开拓者与技术布道者。她是微软 AI MVP、Regional Director，句子互动产品已在千余家大型企业及政府机构落地。

roleOrg.en: Graduate Student, University of Science and Technology of China
roleOrg.zh: 中国科学技术大学研究生

bio.en: Canran Tang is a graduate student at the University of Science and Technology of China. His research focuses on embodied-intelligence infrastructure, robotic middleware, heterogeneous GPU communication, and efficient data exchange for end–edge–cloud robot inference.
bio.zh: 中国科学技术大学研究生，研究方向包括具身智能基础设施、机器人中间件、异构 GPU 通信，以及端—边—云机器人推理中的高效数据交换。

roleOrg.zh: DORA 社区技术负责人

bio.en: Yang Li is the technical lead of the DORA community and a core DORA developer. He is also a core Huawei CANN developer, an M-Robots PMC member, and a core member of the OpenLoong Middleware SIG. He works on embodied-intelligence robot systems and the development and growth of the DORA ecosystem.
bio.zh: DORA 社区技术负责人、DORA 核心开发者，同时是华为 CANN 核心开发者、M-Robots PMC 委员及 OpenLoong 中间件 SIG 核心成员，长期从事具身智能机器人系统研发及 DORA 生态建设。

roleOrg.zh: CSDN 创始人兼董事长、GOSIM 发起人

bio.en: Jiang Tao is the founder and chairman of CSDN and the initiator of GOSIM. Across more than 30 years in software, the internet, and entrepreneurship, he has led products including Giant Handwriting Computer, Kingsoft PowerWord, and Super Decoder, founded Programmer Magazine, and invested in more than 80 technology startups.
bio.zh: CSDN 创始人兼董事长、GOSIM 发起人，拥有三十余年软件、互联网与创业经验。曾参与巨人手写电脑、金山词霸和豪杰超级解霸等产品，创办《程序员》杂志，并投资八十余家科技创业公司。

roleOrg.en: President, Singularity Intelligence Research Institute / Senior Vice President, CSDN
roleOrg.zh: 奇点智能研究院院长、CSDN 合伙人兼高级副总裁

bio.en: Jianzhong Li is President of the Singularity Intelligence Research Institute and Partner and Senior Vice President at CSDN, with extensive research and industry experience in artificial intelligence, technological innovation, and industrial ecosystems. In 2016, he founded the Singularity Intelligence Technology Conference, formerly the Global Machine Learning Technology Conference, which has become an influential forum for advanced technical exchange in the AI industry. His recent research focuses on artificial-intelligence paradigms centered on large models, and he proposed the Paradigm Shift Cube framework for technological innovation. In 2005, he initiated the first Global C++ and System Software Technology Conference, and he is a member of the ISO C++ international standards committee. He also serves on the AI Expert Committee of the Science and Technology Vision Forum at the Tengchong Scientists Forum, where he joined other scientists in publishing Technology Foresight and Future Vision 2049. Through the Singularity Intelligence Research Institute, he provides AI and innovation strategy consulting to organizations including Fortune Global 500 companies.
bio.zh: 李建忠，奇点智能研究院（Singularity Research）院长、CSDN 合伙人兼高级副总裁，在人工智能、技术创新和产业生态领域拥有丰富见解与深入研究经验。2016 年发起创办奇点智能技术大会（原全球机器学习技术大会），该大会已成为人工智能产业领域极具影响力的高端技术研讨与交流平台。近年来主要研究以大模型为主的人工智能范式，提出科技创新的“范式转换立方体”系统框架，相关研究和演讲引起业界广泛关注。2005 年发起举办第一届全球 C++ 及系统软件技术大会，并担任 ISO C++ 国际标准委员会委员。他也是腾冲科学家论坛科技愿景论坛人工智能专家委员会委员，曾联合多位科学家发布《科技预见与未来愿景 2049》。他创立的奇点智能研究院主要研究以大模型为主的人工智能范式，并为包括世界 500 强在内的多家企业提供 AI 与创新战略咨询。

roleOrg.zh: Tensorfer 创始人

bio.en: Zhenwei Pi is the founder of Tensorfer, an AI infrastructure startup. He previously co-founded the compute pillar of ByteDance's IaaS business and is a long-time Linux kernel and QEMU contributor. His current work focuses on system-level performance bottlenecks in large-scale LLM inference, including GPUDirect RDMA weight loading and distributed scheduling.
bio.zh: AI 基础设施创业公司 Tensorfer 创始人，曾联合创建字节跳动 IaaS 业务的计算体系，也是长期的 Linux 内核与 QEMU 贡献者。当前专注于大规模大模型推理中的系统级性能瓶颈，包括 GPUDirect RDMA 权重加载与分布式调度。

roleOrg.zh: Botiverse 联合创始人兼 CEO

bio.en: Yuchao Qian is the co-founder of Raft.build, a multiplayer, multi-agent collaboration platform. He previously created Kimi CLI and NoneBot and has contributed to open-source communities for many years.
bio.zh: 多人多智能体群聊协作平台 Raft.build 联合创始人，曾开发 Kimi CLI 与 NoneBot，长期参与开源社区建设。

roleOrg.en: Assistant Professor, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
roleOrg.zh: 香港中文大学助理教授

bio.en: Weiyang Liu is an Assistant Professor at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
bio.zh: 香港中文大学助理教授。

roleOrg.zh: RoboChallenge 联合创始人

bio.en:
Emily Chen is General Manager of Open Source Strategy & Ecosystem at Dexmal, where she leads the development of the RoboChallenge evaluation platform and competition program. She is a long-time open source practitioner and community leader, dedicated to advancing collaboration between China and the global open source ecosystem. Under her leadership, Kaiyuanshe became the first Chinese Affiliate Member of the Open Source Initiative (OSI). She also initiated several influential projects, including the China Open Source Annual Report and COSCon.
Emily was a contributor to Mozilla, a GSoC mentor, and a TOC Mentor at the OpenAtom Foundation. Recently, she initiated the RoboChallenge platform and community, one of the first large scale real robot evaluation benchmarks for embodied intelligence. With over 20 years of experience, she worked at Sun Microsystems, Oracle, and Microsoft, with expertise in open source governance, cloud computing, and embodied AI.
bio.zh: Emily Chen 负责 Dexmal 的开源战略与生态，并推动 RoboChallenge 评测平台和赛事体系建设。她长期参与全球开源社区，曾任开源社负责人，也是中国开源年度报告、COSCon 等项目的发起者之一，近年来专注于具身智能的真实机器人评测与开放基准。

roleOrg.en: AI Infrastructure & Open Source Lead, Dexmal
roleOrg.zh: Dexmal AI 基础设施与开源负责人

bio.en: Haibin Zhang leads AI infrastructure and the OpenDM and Dexbotic open-source projects at Dexmal. His current work focuses on scalable data, training, evaluation, and inference infrastructure for embodied AI. He has previously worked on Brain++, MegEngine, and autonomous-driving infrastructure, with extensive experience in AI systems and data flywheels.
bio.zh: Haibin Zhang 负责 Dexmal 的 AI 基础设施以及 OpenDM、Dexbotic 等开源项目，当前专注于具身智能领域可扩展的数据、训练、评测与推理基础设施，曾参与 Brain++、MegEngine 和自动驾驶基础设施建设。

roleOrg.zh: 华为技术有限公司软件工程师

bio.en: Cong Wang is a software engineer at Huawei Technologies specializing in KV-cache acceleration for large-language-model inference. His work spans high-performance computing, inference acceleration, and AI infrastructure. He currently leads architecture design, core development, and open-source community work for UCM, Huawei's Unified Cache Manager.
bio.zh: 王聪是华为技术有限公司软件工程师，专注于大语言模型推理中的 KV Cache 加速、高性能计算与 AI 基础设施。目前负责统一缓存管理器 UCM 的架构设计、核心功能开发与开源社区运营。

roleOrg.zh: 东南大学硕士研究生

bio.en: Longhang Deng is a master’s student at Southeast University. His research focuses on agent operating systems and agent security, including autonomous agents that generate and validate runtime defenses for kernel vulnerabilities.
bio.zh: Longhang Deng 是东南大学硕士研究生，研究方向包括智能体操作系统与智能体安全，重点探索能够为内核漏洞自动生成并验证运行时防护的自主智能体。

roleOrg.zh: 联合讲师

bio.en: Dongbiao He is a co-presenter of “An Autonomous Runtime Shielding Agent for Linux Kernel Vulnerabilities” at GOSIM Shenzhen 2026.
bio.zh: Dongbiao He 将在 GOSIM 深圳 2026 联合分享《面向 Linux 内核漏洞的自主运行时防护智能体》。

roleOrg.zh: 纽卡斯尔大学助理教授

bio.en: Zhenghao Chen is a Lecturer, equivalent to Assistant Professor, at the University of Newcastle, Australia. He received his bachelor’s degree with first-class honours and his Ph.D. from the University of Sydney in 2017 and 2022. He has worked at TikTok, the University of Sydney, Microsoft Research, and Disney Research. His research spans generative AI, embodied AI, AI for science, and multimedia, with publications in venues including CVPR, ICCV, ICML, ICLR, ECCV, and AAAI. He focuses on translating research into practical industrial and cross-disciplinary applications.
bio.zh: 澳大利亚纽卡斯尔大学助理教授，研究方向涵盖生成式 AI、具身智能、AI for Science 与多媒体。他曾在 TikTok、悉尼大学、微软研究院和迪士尼研究院从事研究工作，长期关注高效且可部署的智能系统。

roleOrg.en: PhD Student, National University of Singapore
roleOrg.zh: 新加坡国立大学博士生

bio.en: Guibin Zhang is a Ph.D. student in the School of Computing at the National University of Singapore.
bio.zh: 新加坡国立大学计算机学院博士生。

roleOrg.zh: 复旦大学硕士研究生

bio.en: Jiahang Lin is a master’s student at Fudan University’s FudanNLP Lab, co-advised by Tao Gui and Xuanjing Huang. His research focuses on self-evolving agents and reinforcement learning. His experience spans supervised fine-tuning with DeepSpeed and LLaMA-Factory, reinforcement learning with verl and trl, and agent harness engineering. He is a research intern at NEX-AGI and previously interned at Huawei’s Computing Research Department. He received his bachelor’s degree from Fudan University in 2025.
bio.zh: 复旦大学 FudanNLP 实验室硕士研究生，研究方向为自演进智能体与强化学习，具备 SFT、强化学习和 Harness Engineering 的完整实践经验，现于 NEX-AGI 从事研究实习。

roleOrg.zh: Approaching.AI 大模型系统架构师

bio.en: Hongbo Kang is an architect at Approaching.AI and holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from Tsinghua University. His work spans large language model inference, AI infrastructure, processing-in-memory, high-performance in-memory indexing, data placement, and task scheduling. His research has appeared in SPAA, PVLDB/VLDB, The VLDB Journal, and PPoPP, with PIM-tree receiving the VLDB 2023 Best Research Paper Runner-up Award. He was a Research Fellow at the Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing at UC Berkeley. His current focus is on cross-platform LLM deployment, inference optimization, and software–hardware co-design for emerging computing platforms.
bio.zh: Approaching.AI 架构师、清华大学计算机博士，研究涵盖大模型推理、AI 基础设施、存内计算、数据放置与任务调度。目前专注于跨平台大模型部署、推理优化及软硬件协同设计。

roleOrg.zh: 东南大学副研究员

bio.en: Ying Wan is an Associate Researcher at Southeast University. He received his Ph.D. from Tsinghua University and was a visiting scholar at the University of Victoria. Before joining Southeast University, he was a Senior Network Researcher at China Mobile Cloud. His research focuses on data center networking, AI cluster interconnects, software-defined networking, and programmable data planes, with particular interests in high-speed network measurement, and traffic scheduling for large-scale AI systems. He has published 28 papers in venues including ACM SIGCOMM, USENIX NSDI, IEEE INFOCOM and IEEE/ACM ToN.
bio.zh: 东南大学副研究员，清华大学博士，曾任中国移动云高级网络研究员。研究方向包括数据中心网络、AI 集群互联、软件定义网络和可编程数据平面。

roleOrg.zh: HAFleet 开源项目维护者

bio.en: Yue Zhao maintains the HAFleet open-source project, focusing on the organization and coordination of multiple AI agents through role assignment, group communication, task handoffs, and human participation. The session presents collaborative coding with HAFleet and shows how people and agents can work together in a shared interface using Robrix2.
bio.zh: 赵悦是 HAFleet 开源项目维护者，关注多智能体的组织与协作，围绕角色分工、群组沟通、任务交接和人类参与开展项目维护与探索。本次分享以 HAFleet 为核心，介绍智能体协作编程的实践，并结合 Robrix2 展示人和智能体在同一界面中协作的方式。

roleOrg.zh: 独立软件开发者

bio.en: Alex Wang is an independent software developer and AI agent enthusiast.
bio.zh: Alex Wang 是独立软件开发者，也是一名 AI 智能体爱好者。

roleOrg.zh: Approaching.AI 首席架构师

bio.en: Weiyu Xie is Chief Architect at Approaching.AI. He received his Ph.D. from the Institute for High Performance Computing in Tsinghua University’s Department of Computer Science and Technology. His research interests include agent systems, large language model inference, graph computing, and databases.
bio.zh: Approaching.AI 首席架构师，清华大学计算机科学与技术系高性能计算研究所博士，研究方向包括智能体系统、大语言模型推理、图计算与数据库。

roleOrg.zh: 智子芯元（深圳）科技有限责任公司创始人

bio.en: Tian Ding is the founder of Zhizi Xinyuan and an Associate Researcher at the Shenzhen Institute of Big Data. His research focuses on large-model training, operations research, and computational acceleration. He leads the development of KernelCAT, an AI agent for kernel development, model migration, framework tuning, and deployment optimization, with adaptations for domestic chips.
bio.zh: 丁添博士是智子芯元（深圳）科技有限责任公司创始人、深圳市大数据研究院副研究员，长期专注于大模型训练、运筹优化与计算加速。他带领团队研发计算加速智能体 KernelCAT，覆盖算子开发、模型迁移、框架调优与部署优化，并针对国产芯片特性进行优化。

roleOrg.zh: 中国电信研究院互联网技术研究所主任

bio.en: Lei Bo, Director of the Internet Technology Research Institute at the Research Institute of China Telecom Corporation Limited. He graduated from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT) with a master's degree, and is mainly engaged in research on new network technologies, including computing power networks, intelligent computing networks, and agent networks.
bio.zh: 中国电信研究院互联网技术研究所主任，北京邮电大学硕士，主要从事算力网络、智算网络和智能体网络等新型网络技术研究。

roleOrg.en: FlexKV Core Maintainer & Senior Engineer, Tencent Cloud
roleOrg.zh: FlexKV 核心维护者、腾讯云高级工程师

bio.en: Feiqiang Sun is a Senior Engineer at Tencent Cloud with nine years of cloud-computing R&D experience. His work covers high-performance data-center networking and storage, protocol stacks, RDMA optimization, and AI infrastructure. As a core maintainer of FlexKV, he advances enterprise adoption of KV-cache optimization technologies.
bio.zh: 腾讯云高级工程师，拥有九年云计算研发经验，长期从事高性能数据中心网络与存储、协议栈、RDMA 网络性能优化和 AI 基础设施研发。作为 FlexKV 开源社区核心维护者，推动大模型 KV Cache 优化技术在企业级产品中的落地。

roleOrg.zh: 南洋理工大学博士研究员

bio.en: Zhifei Xie is a PhD researcher at Nanyang Technological University focusing on audio-visual interaction.
bio.zh: 南洋理工大学博士研究员，研究方向为音视频交互。

roleOrg.en: Researcher, Institute of Advanced Technology, USTC
roleOrg.zh: 中国科大先进技术研究院研究员

bio.en: Dr. Yu Huang is a researcher at the Institute of Advanced Technology, University of Science and Technology of China. He previously held senior autonomous-driving and research roles at SAIC Z-ONE, Black Sesame Technologies, Singulato, Baidu Research USA, Intel, Huawei Research USA, and Samsung Research USA.
bio.zh: 中国科大先进技术研究院研究员，曾任上汽零束科技智驾首席科学家、黑芝麻智能科技研究副总裁和奇点汽车美研首席科学家兼总裁，也曾在百度美研、Intel、华为美研和三星美研工作。已发表四十余篇国际学术论文并获得十七项欧美专利。

roleOrg.en: PhD Student, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications
roleOrg.zh: 重庆邮电大学博士生

bio.en: Yongcheng Wei is a PhD student in the School of Automation at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications, focusing on embodied intelligence.
bio.zh: 重庆邮电大学自动化学院在读博士生，研究方向为具身智能。

roleOrg.zh: AtomGit CEO、CSDN 高级副总裁

bio.en: Bangxu Yu is Senior Vice President of CSDN and CEO of AtomGit. He previously held technology management roles at Weibo, LeCloud, and iQIYI. He leads AtomGit's domestic open-source code platform and the AtomCode family of AI coding tools, advancing the platform toward AI agents and model engineering.
bio.zh: CSDN 高级副总裁、AtomGit CEO，曾任职于微博、乐视云和爱奇艺技术管理岗位，拥有云平台架构建设经验。现负责 AtomGit 国产开源代码平台及 AtomCode 系列 AI 编程工具，推动平台向 AI 智能体与模型工程化方向升级。

roleOrg.zh: Second State 创始人

bio.en: Michael Yuan is a founder, investor, and agentic engineer focused on open-source AI and Rust.
bio.zh: Second State 创始人、投资人和智能体工程师，专注于开源 AI 与 Rust。

roleOrg.zh: ShannonTek 创始人

bio.en: Hunter Bown is the founder of ShannonTek and the creator of Codewhale (formerly DeepSeek-TUI), an open-source AI coding agent written in Rust. A musician and former high school band director, he came to software and AI through a broader interest in how people learn, create, and turn ideas into reality. His work brings together model-agnostic agent systems, open-source collaboration, and tools that make advanced capabilities accessible beyond specialist teams. Based in San Francisco, he is building toward a simple goal: helping more people turn what they know, notice, and imagine into things they can do.
bio.zh: ShannonTek 创始人、开源 Rust AI 编码智能体 Codewhale（原 DeepSeek-TUI）的创建者。他曾是音乐人和高中乐队指导教师，现专注于模型无关的智能体系统、开源协作，以及让先进 AI 能力惠及更多人的开发工具。

roleOrg.zh: AWS 首席解决方案架构师

bio.en: Frank Fan is a Principal Container Solutions Architect at AWS in Australia, with more than 20 years of experience designing and implementing large-scale technology transformations. He specializes in containerization and migration and has spoken at AWS re:Invent, AWS Summit, and API Days.
bio.zh: AWS 澳大利亚首席容器解决方案架构师，拥有二十余年大型技术转型设计与实施经验，专注于容器化和迁移实践，曾在 AWS re:Invent、AWS Summit 和 API Days 等技术活动发表演讲。

roleOrg.zh: 联合讲师

bio.en: Sheng Chen is a co-presenter of “Building Hybrid AI Systems: Edge Inference Meets Cloud Reasoning” at GOSIM Shenzhen 2026.
bio.zh: Sheng Chen 将在 GOSIM 深圳 2026 联合分享《构建混合 AI 系统：边缘推理与云端推理协同》。

roleOrg.zh: X-Era Lab 研发总监、PhyAgentOS 联合创始人

bio.en: Tao Pu is R&D Director at X-Era Lab and Co-founder of PhyAgentOS.
bio.zh: X-Era Lab 研发总监、PhyAgentOS 联合创始人。

roleOrg.en: vLLM Community Ambassador, CTO of Red Hat Greater China
roleOrg.zh: vLLM 社区大使、红帽大中华区 CTO

bio.en: Jiaju Zhang is CTO for Greater China at Red Hat and a vLLM community ambassador. He has more than twenty years of experience in open-source software, Linux, distributed systems, storage, virtualization, cloud computing, containers, cloud-native technologies, and AI infrastructure.
bio.zh: Red Hat 大中华区 CTO、vLLM 社区大使，拥有二十余年开源软件、Linux、分布式系统、存储、高可用、虚拟化、云计算、容器、云原生和 AI 基础设施经验，致力于 AI 推理开源项目孵化、社区建设与产业落地。

roleOrg.en: Director of Sales & Marketing, M5Stack Technology Co., Ltd
roleOrg.zh: M5Stack 销售与市场总监

bio.en: Allen Chao is Director of Sales and Marketing at M5Stack. He is a technology enthusiast and football fan with a curiosity for new ideas.
bio.zh: Allen Chao 是 M5Stack 销售与市场总监，也是一名科技爱好者和足球迷，始终对新事物保持好奇。

roleOrg.en: Chief Marketing Officer, Shenzhen Ciyuan Kaiwu Technology
roleOrg.zh: 深圳词源开物科技有限公司首席市场官

bio.en: Zhongpeng Zheng, also known as Zayn, is a co-founder of a startup incubated by the Shenzhen Kechuang Academy. The team develops PCB printers and an AI-assisted hardware IDE under the IterxAI project.
bio.zh: 郑仲鹏（Zayn）是深圳科创学院孵化创业团队的联合创始人，团队围绕 IterxAI 开发 PCB 打印机与 AI 硬件集成开发环境，帮助用户将硬件创意转化为原型。

roleOrg.zh: 幻尔海外市场策略负责人

bio.en: Lee Chun Pak leads overseas market strategy at Hiwonder, bringing open-source AI educational robots to international markets. He works with schools and partners to help students apply embodied AI to robots.
bio.zh: Lee Chun Pak 负责幻尔的海外市场策略，推动开源 AI 教育机器人进入国际市场，并与学校及合作伙伴协作，帮助学生将具身智能应用于机器人。

roleOrg.zh: Inferact 工程师

bio.en: Ziming Huang is an engineer at Inferact and a contributor to the vLLM community.
bio.zh: 黄梓铭是 Inferact 工程师，也是 vLLM 社区贡献者。

roleOrg.zh: Noitom Robotics 创始人兼首席执行官

bio.en: Dr. Ruoli Dai, founder of Noitom Robotics and co-founder of Noitom Ltd., focuses on human motion digitization, human–machine interaction and robot learning. He earned his bachelor’s degree at USTC and Ph.D. at CUHK, with distinguished alumni honors from CUHK’s Department of Mechanical and Automation Engineering and Faculty of Engineering. He holds 50+ international patents and led motion capture development spanning inertial, optical and multi-sensor fusion technologies. At GOSIM CHINA 2024, he first proposed “A Mocap-based Data Factory for Embodied AI” and began putting it into practice. He founded Noitom Robotics in 2025, applying over a decade of human digitization expertise to embodied AI data infrastructure, multimodal human behavior data, robot teleoperation and large-scale data production. In 2026, he led ModalityNet’s launch and dataset open-sourcing to make the real world learnable by capturing and compiling human interactions into training data for robot foundation models.
bio.zh: Tristan Ruoli Dai 博士是 Noitom Robotics 创始人、Noitom 联合创始人，专注于人体运动数字化、人机交互和机器人学习。他本科毕业于中国科学技术大学，获香港中文大学博士学位，并获该校机械与自动化工程学系及工程学院杰出校友荣誉。他拥有 50 余项国际专利，曾主导惯性、光学及多传感器融合动作捕捉技术研发。2024 年，他在 GOSIM CHINA 首次提出并实践“基于动作捕捉的具身智能数据工厂”。2025 年创立 Noitom Robotics，将十余年人体数字化经验应用于具身智能数据基础设施、多模态人体行为数据、机器人遥操作和规模化数据生产。2026 年，他带领团队发布 ModalityNet 并开放数据集，将真实世界中的人类交互转化为机器人基础模型的训练数据。

roleOrg.zh: LMCache 核心架构师

bio.en: Chunxiao Zheng (GitHub: chunxiaozheng) is a maintainer and core architect of LMCache, an open-source KV-cache management layer for LLM inference. With more than 100 merged pull requests, he is among the project’s top five contributors. His work includes MLA and DSA support, I/O optimization, and command-line tooling.
bio.zh: Chunxiao Zheng（GitHub：chunxiaozheng）是大语言模型推理开源 KV Cache 管理层 LMCache 的维护者和核心架构师，已合入 100 余项代码贡献，位列项目前五位贡献者。他的工作包括 MLA 与 DSA 支持、I/O 流程优化和命令行工具开发。

roleOrg.en: R&D Engineer, Daorui Intelligent Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd.
roleOrg.zh: Daorui Intelligent Technology（北京）研发工程师

bio.en: Yujie Sun is an R&D engineer at Daorui Intelligent Technology (Beijing) and an advocate for the DORA project.
bio.zh: Yujie Sun 是 Daorui Intelligent Technology（北京）的研发工程师，也是 DORA 项目的技术布道者。

roleOrg.zh: RadixArk 技术团队成员

bio.en: Yichi Zhang is an SGLang developer focused on efficient LLM inference, with an interest in KV cache management and optimization. He is also a core developer of sglang-omni, building inference engines for omni-modal, TTS, and ASR models. He leads community education and developer relations efforts within the SGLang community and is the initiator and a core developer of zero-to-sglang, SGLang’s official course.
bio.zh: Yichi Zhang 是 SGLang 开发者，专注于高效大语言模型推理，尤其关注 KV Cache 管理与优化。他也是 sglang-omni 核心开发者，参与全模态、文本转语音（TTS）和自动语音识别（ASR）模型推理引擎的建设。他负责 SGLang 社区的教育与开发者关系工作，是官方课程 zero-to-sglang 的发起者和核心开发者。

roleOrg.en: vLLM AFD-Plugin Committer, Engineer at Huawei
roleOrg.zh: vLLM AFD-Plugin 代码提交者、华为工程师

bio.en: Chenzhou Jiang is an AI Infrastructure Engineer at Huawei and a maintainer of the afd-plugin repository in the vLLM community. He earned his master’s degree from the Department of Computer Science at Nanjing University in 2020 and previously contributed to HarmonyOS research and development. His current work focuses on AI inference, with a particular interest in disaggregated inference architectures, including Attention–FFN Disaggregation (AFD) and Encoder–Prefill–Decode (EPD) disaggregation.
bio.zh: 江晨舟是华为 AI 基础设施工程师，也是 vLLM 社区 afd-plugin 仓库的维护者。他于 2020 年获南京大学计算机系硕士学位，此前参与 HarmonyOS 研发。目前专注于 AI 推理，重点研究 Attention–FFN 分离（AFD）和编码–预填充–解码分离（EPD）等推理架构。

roleOrg.en: Senior Inference Engineer, Tencent Hunyuan Team
roleOrg.zh: 腾讯混元团队高级推理工程师

bio.en: landojiang is a Senior Inference Engineer on Tencent’s Hunyuan team and holds a master’s degree from Peking University. His work focuses on high-performance computing, inference-system optimization, and GPU kernel development. As a core developer, he has contributed to inference optimization across multiple generations of Hunyuan models and to the development and open-sourcing of HPC-Ops, a high-performance kernel library used as an official backend by vLLM and SGLang.
bio.zh: landojiang 是腾讯混元团队高级推理工程师，硕士毕业于北京大学，专注于高性能计算、推理系统优化和 GPU 算子开发。他作为核心开发者，参与多代混元模型的推理优化，以及高性能算子库 HPC-Ops 的研发与开源工作；该算子库已成为 vLLM 与 SGLang 的官方后端。

roleOrg.zh: Boao Open School 创始人

bio.en: Qiu Qinlun is an industry–education collaboration specialist with nearly 30 years of experience in IT education. He co-founded Easthome, an IT certification training institution, and co-established a software school with the Open University of China. In 2025, he founded Boao Open School to develop AI-interactive classrooms around self-learning, co-learning, and leading others in learning. His work combines open-source tools, interactive teaching, and industry partnerships to help learners become active participants in AI-assisted creation.
bio.zh: Qiu Qinlun 是产教融合专家，拥有近 30 年 IT 教育经验。他曾联合创办 IT 认证培训机构 Easthome，并与国家开放大学共同创办软件学院。2025 年，他创立 Boao Open School，以 AI 交互式课堂推动“自学—共学—领学”的递进学习方法。他的工作结合开源工具、互动教学和产教融合，帮助学习者从被动接收内容转向主动参与 AI 辅助的共同创作。

roleOrg.zh: 宇万智能 EvoPhys 联合创始人兼首席运营官

bio.en: Zhongxia Zhao is Co-Founder and COO of EvoPhys AI. He holds a master’s degree from Peking University and previously served as a technology director at a listed AI company and an embodied-AI researcher at the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence. He is also an embodied-technology advisor to ITU. With ten years of experience deploying robotics and AI systems, he has contributed to dozens of robotics patents and more than ten embodied-AI standards. His work focuses on physical AGI, five-dimensional world models, real-world spatial modeling, and multi-robot coordination across home, industrial, and rail-transit applications.
bio.zh: 赵仲夏是宇万智能 EvoPhys 联合创始人兼首席运营官，北京大学硕士，曾任 AI 上市公司技术总监、智源研究院具身智能研究员，并担任 ITU 具身技术顾问。他拥有十年机器人与人工智能落地经验，参与数十项机器人专利及十余项具身智能标准制定，专注于物理 AGI 与五维世界模型，主导实景空间建模、多机器人协同等系统研发，应用覆盖家庭、工业和轨道交通等场景。

roleOrg.zh: CODATA 人工智能与互操作性负责人

bio.en: Head of AI and Interoperability at CODATA. With over 25 years’ experience in software development, data science, and European research infrastructures (EOSC), Slava is an innovator, IT architect, and mentor who has focused much of his career on research and education through experimentation, pilot projects, and inventive problem-solving methods. He is a Harvard Dataverse Ambassador (since June 2025) and co-author of the Google-initiated CroissantML standard for AI.
bio.zh: Slava Tykhonov 是 CODATA 人工智能与互操作性负责人，拥有超过 25 年软件开发、数据科学及欧洲科研基础设施（EOSC）经验。他兼任技术架构师与导师，长期通过实验和试点项目推动科研与教育创新。自 2025 年 6 月起，他担任 Harvard Dataverse 大使，并参与编写由 Google 发起的 AI 数据标准 CroissantML。

roleOrg.zh: Makepad 联合创始人

bio.en: Rik Arends is a co-founder of Makepad with more than 20 years of experience developing in C/C++, JavaScript, and Rust. His work focuses on high-performance visual and audio applications and the tools needed to build them. He previously developed VJ software, web interfaces, and the Cloud9 web IDE. At Makepad, he is rethinking Rust development workflows and exploring how AI can help developers write Rust and user-interface code.
bio.zh: Rik Arends 是 Makepad 联合创始人，拥有超过 20 年 C/C++、JavaScript 和 Rust 开发经验，长期关注高性能视觉、音频应用及其开发工具。他曾开发 VJ 视觉演出软件、Web 界面和 Cloud9 在线集成开发环境。目前，他通过 Makepad 探索新的 Rust 开发工作流，以及如何利用 AI 编写 Rust 和用户界面代码。

bio.zh: Zedong Liu 是中国科学院计算技术研究所博士研究生，研究大模型推理优化与 KV Cache 压缩，致力于构建高效、可扩展的分布式推理系统。其研究成果发表于 ACM SIGCOMM、ACM PPoPP、SC 和 NeurIPS。

bio.zh: 赵松是深蓝学院联合创始人兼 CEO，中国科学院自动化研究所硕士，自 2012 年起从事人工智能与机器人研发。深蓝学院长期专注于人工智能、机器人和自动驾驶教育。
